## 1. Executive Summary

This document provides a comprehensive technical extraction and architectural reference of all visual layouts, design tokens, UI components, agent drawer mechanics, ODAEA (Observe, Decide, Act, Evaluate, Adapt) event streaming schemas, HTTP 503 failure interception details, and static assets from the PeoplePulse codebase.

This reference is specifically structured to enable the autonomous construction of the standalone 5-minute interactive video presentation player in `d:/project/PeoplePulse/demo_video_player`.

## 3. Dashboard Structure, Visual Layouts & Cards

### 3.1 Main Dashboard Layout Grid
The PeoplePulse app uses a two-pane layout:
1. **Sidebar Navigation** (Left column, fixed/sticky, `w-64` / 256px width, `bg-white`, border-r `#E6E7EA`):
   - Header: Logo image (`/logo.png`, 32x32px), Brand text "PeoplePulse" (`text-[16px] font-bold text-[#1F2A28]`).
   - Organization pill: Active organization name (e.g. "Acme Corp"), plan label ("Pro Plan" or "Enterprise Plan").
   - Navigation list:
     - Admin: Overview (Home), Insights (TrendingUp), Employees (UserPlus), Teams (Layers), Questions (ListChecks), Imports (UploadCloud), Settings (Settings).
     - Manager: Overview (Home), Insights (TrendingUp), Employees (UserPlus), Teams (Layers), Questions (ListChecks), Imports (UploadCloud), Settings (Settings).
     - Employee: Your wellbeing (Home), Daily Check-in (MessageSquare), Settings (Settings).
   - PulseAgent Copilot Quick Launcher: Gradient button (`from-blue-50/90 to-indigo-50/80`, border-blue-200, Sparkles icon).
   - User profile footer: User avatar initials, name, role badge (`ADMIN` / `MANAGER` / `EMPLOYEE`), sign out icon.
2. **Main Canvas Area** (`flex-1 min-w-0 p-5 sm:p-8 bg-[#F7F7F5]`):
   - **Topbar**:
     - Left: Greeting (e.g. "Good morning, Sarah 👋" or "Organization Overview"), subtitle with team count and cycle range.
     - Right: Live indicator pill (`bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200/60`, pulsing dot), weekly cycle badge, team selector dropdown, date picker.
   - **PulseAgent AI Showcase Banner Card**:
     - Bot icon in `#4E6ABF` box, "PulseAgent HR Copilot", "Active" badge, description: "Monitors employee wellbeing, spots burnout early, and provides actionable 1:1 talking points", "Open PulseAgent" button.
   - **4-Column KPI Card Metric Grid**:
     1. *Organization Members*: Value `48` (Unit: `/ 100`).
     2. *Active Teams*: Value `4`.
     3. *Daily Participation*: Value `75%` (Unit: `36 / 48`), sub-pill "Realtime" with pulsing dot.
     4. *Org. Engagement*: Value `68` (Unit: `/ 100`), Delta pill `+2.5%`, note "Resets every Saturday".
   - **Analytical Charts Grid**:
     - *Left*: Organization Engagement Line Chart (`ResponsiveContainer`, `LineChart`, stroke `#4E6ABF`, dot filled `#4E6ABF`).
     - *Right*: Team Comparison Horizontal Bar Chart (`BarChart`, layout `vertical`, bars in `#4E6ABF` with radius `[0, 6, 6, 0]`, displaying Customer Success: 42, Engineering: 82, Sales: 74, Product: 88).
   - **Dimension Breakdown**:
     - 5 Horizontal progress bars on 1-5 scale:
       1. Workload Manageability (`2.4 / 5.0`)
       2. Manager Support (`3.8 / 5.0`)
       3. Team Collaboration (`4.1 / 5.0`)
       4. Motivation & Energy (`3.2 / 5.0`)
       5. Stress Balance (`2.2 / 5.0`)
   - **Privacy Guard Notice (n ≥ 3 Rule)**:
     - Blue card with `ShieldCheck` icon: "Privacy Threshold Active (n ≥ 3 Rule). Team metrics and anonymous comments require at least 3 submissions to protect individual identities."

## 6. HTTP 503 Failure Interception & Emergency Reroute

### 6.1 The Failure Interception Mechanism
The primary differentiator of PeoplePulse in the hackathon rubric is **Stage 5: Adaptation**.

1. **Tool Invocation (`simulate_and_handle_failure`)**:
   - The agent sends an HTTP POST to `https://httpstat.us/503?sleep=1000` with payload `{"event": "urgent_manager_alert", "organization_id": "..."}`.
   - Timeout is guarded at 1200ms.
   - Endpoint returns `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`.
   - Tool catches error, notes `duration_ms: 1054`, sets `adaptation_required: true`, and returns:
     ```json
     {
       "scenario": "Controlled Resilience Test Harness (HTTP 503 Interception)",
       "primary_attempt": {
         "target_channel": "slack_incident_webhook",
         "status": "FAILED",
         "error": "HTTP 503 Service Unavailable from primary webhook endpoint",
         "duration_ms": 1054,
         "timestamp": "2026-09-11T18:20:07.120Z"
       },
       "adaptation_required": true,
       "suggested_fallback": "send_emergency_notification",
       "recommendation": "Switch immediately from external webhook to internal emergency escalation queue."
     }
     ```

2. **Autonomous Adaptation Event Trigger**:
   - The engine checks `toolResult?.adaptation_required || toolName === "simulate_and_handle_failure"`.
   - Emits `AGENT_EVENT_TYPES.ADAPTATION`:
     ```json
     {
       "type": "adaptation",
       "payload": {
         "trigger": "HTTP 503 Service Unavailable from primary webhook endpoint",
         "adaptive_strategy": "Switch immediately from external webhook to internal emergency escalation queue.",
         "autonomous": true
       },
       "timestamp": "2026-09-11T18:20:07.200Z"
     }
     ```

3. **Stage 5: Adaptation Card Appearance in UI**:
   - **Card Styling**: `p-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-50 to-amber-50 border-2 border-orange-400 text-xs shadow-xs animate-pop-in`
   - **Header**:
     - Shield icon `🛡️`
     - Title: `STAGE 5: ADAPTATION (FAILURE INTERCEPTION & SELF-CORRECTION)` (`text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase text-orange-900`)
     - Right Badge: `SELF-CORRECTED` (`text-[9px] bg-orange-200 text-orange-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wider`)
   - **Body**:
     - `text-orange-950 font-medium`: "Switch immediately from external webhook to internal emergency escalation queue."
     - `text-[10px] text-orange-800 mt-1 font-mono`: "Trigger: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable from primary webhook endpoint"

4. **Self-Healing Recovery Action**:
   - The agent calls `send_emergency_notification` with args:
     ```json
     {
       "title": "Urgent: Team Workload & Burnout Alert",
       "message": "Primary webhook failed (HTTP 503). Autonomously rerouted to emergency in-app queue.",
       "priority": "high"
     }
     ```
   - Persists to local storage and Supabase `agent_activity_logs` with `{ failover: true, delivery_channel: "emergency_in_app_queue" }`.
   - Observation: `"Urgent alert successfully routed and verified via fallback channel: Emergency In-App Queue. Zero message loss."`
   - Evaluation: `"Emergency escalation verified and delivered via Emergency In-App Queue. Zero message loss achieved through autonomous failover."`

### Event 10: Stage 6 — Outcome & Final Resolution
- **Card Styling**: `p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-emerald-500 shadow-md text-xs space-y-3 animate-scale-in`
- **Header**:
  - Green circular check icon (`w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center`)
  - Title: `Stage 6: Outcome & Final Resolution`
  - Model Badge: `Gemini 2.0 Flash` (`text-[9px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full`)

- **What We Found Box**:
  `p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 text-gray-800 font-medium leading-relaxed`:
  "Demonstration Workflow Completed: System autonomously executed the full Goal → Decision → Action → Evaluation → Adaptation → Outcome loop, successfully recovering from environmental network failure with zero data loss."
- **Summary Stats (2-Column Grid)**:
  - Engagement: `68/100`
  - Active Employees: `48`
  - Active Teams: `4`
  - Failover Delivery: `100% (Zero Loss)`
- **Key Discoveries Bullets**:

- **Actions Autonomous Agent Executed**:

  - Completed deep check-in diagnosis and burnout analysis for Customer Success
  - Executed network resilience test: Intercepted webhook timeout (HTTP 503)
  - Autonomously rerouted urgent notice to emergency in-app queue (100% delivered)
- **Recommended Next Step (Blue Box)**:

### 7.1 Audit Trail Activity Log Schema
In Tab 2 (`Audit Trail`), historical actions are shown:
```typescript
interface AuditRecord {
  id: string; // e.g. "act_1726078800123_abcde"
  timestamp: string; // ISO 8601
  organizationId: string;
  userEmail: string; // e.g. "alex.morgan@company.com"
  goal: string;
  tool: string;
  status: "completed" | "failed" | "adapted" | "blocked";
  input: Record<string, any>; // Redacted of secrets
  outcome: string;
  adaptation: Record<string, any> | null;
}
```

| **0:00 – 0:45** | Minute 1 | **Stage 1: Goal Context** | PeoplePulse Dashboard: 4 KPI Cards (Members, Teams, Participation, Org Engagement: 68%), Team list, Live Realtime status pill. |
| **0:45 – 1:30** | Minute 2 | **Stage 2: Decision Framework** | Trigger PulseAgent floating button → Slide-out drawer opens → Showcase 6-stage breadcrumb bar, ReAct loop, Gemini model badge. |
| **1:30 – 2:40** | Minute 3 | **Stage 3: Action & Stage 4: Evaluation** | Trigger preset "Demonstrate Full Agentic Workflow" → Goal card (Stage 1) → Decision card (Stage 2) → Action card (Stage 3, `get_organization_metrics`) → Observation card (68% org, CS drop) → Evaluation card (Stage 4) → CS Team diagnosis (`diagnose_team_health`, 42% score). |
| **2:40 – 3:45** | Minute 4 | **Stage 5: Adaptation (Core Differentiator)** | Attempt external webhook alert → Intercept HTTP 503 error (`simulate_and_handle_failure`) → Prominent Orange Card: `Stage 5: Adaptation (Self-Corrected)` → Autonomously executes `send_emergency_notification` via in-app queue. |
| **3:45 – 4:25** | Minute 5 (Part A) | **Stage 6: Outcome** | Large Green Outcome Card (Stage 6: Final Resolution, summary stats, action checkmarks) → Switch to `Audit Trail` tab showing immutable sanitized action log. |
| **4:25 – 5:00** | Minute 5 (Part B) | **Wrap-Up & Technical Defense** | Terminal test run overlay (`23 passing tests in 511ms`) → Return to Dashboard with 100% failover delivery & n ≥ 3 privacy badge → Strong closing slide. |

## 10. Conclusion & Handoff Readiness

The PeoplePulse codebase contains all design assets, component styling, color palettes, mock datasets, and functional workflows necessary to build a high-fidelity, interactive HTML5 presentation player. All details documented above are directly actionable by downstream player architecture and frontend implementation agents.
